items.label: Chunk size
items.description: Placeholder. The size of one chunk, in meters per side. Only chunks near the camera are built and shown.

items.label: View distance
items.description: Placeholder. How many chunks out from the camera's own chunk are built and shown, in every direction. R6b: sized to what the camera can actually see at its maximum zoom-out (about 320 m), plus one chunk of margin - zoom-out is limited by design, so chunks further out are never built or rendered. R9: the maximum is capped at 6 chunks.

items.label: Trees per chunk
items.description: TEMPORARY placeholder (R6b), until the real map design exists. How many trees are randomly placed in a chunk when it's first created. R17: raised from 20 to 60 (3x), per design.

items.label: Stones per chunk
items.description: TEMPORARY placeholder (R6b), until the real map design exists. How many stones are randomly placed in a chunk when it's first created. R17: raised from 3 to 5 (1.5x is 4.5, rounded up), per design.
